name: schema-semantic-data-contract
explain: Demonstrate that structural schema validation alone misses semantic unit shifts (dollars to cents), corrupting business logic unless enforced by semantic data contracts.

name: elt-raw-replay-repair
explain: Contrast rigid in-flight ETL transforms with replayable ELT architectures, enforcing authoritative tombstone deletion filters during historical replays.
steps: Demonstrate transformation bug affecting downstream financial projections. || Replay immutable raw landed events through the fixed transformation logic. || Assert that repaired figures are correct while tombstoned accounts remain deleted.

name: cdc-atomic-checkpoint-idempotency
explain: Guard Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines against duplicate business effects caused by worker crashes before broker offset acknowledgment.
steps: Simulate worker crash after database write but before broker checkpoint commit. || Re-deliver CDC event on worker restart. || Assert that monotonic revision checks absorb duplicates without double-crediting balances.
expect: All CDC atomic checkpoint idempotency assertions verified successfully.

name: event-time-watermark-panes
explain: Contrast accumulating streaming panes with downstream additive aggregation to prevent double-counting late-arriving event updates.
steps: Emit initial on-time window pane followed by late-corrected accumulating pane. || Show that naive summing produces inflated double-counted totals. || Assert that keyed upsert sinks reflect exact window state.
expect: All event time watermark pane assertions verified successfully.

name: immutable-manifest-lineage-audit
